why_this_file_exists: THE ONE PLACE A PER-TASK FLOOR IS RECORDED for ISMS-IA. Read by lib/task-floors.mjs, which verify-cert and check-task-map both call. An override with no `ruled_in` is an ERROR, not a pass.

the_rule.derivation: min(default_floor, 2 x effective primaries). The cap of 2 items per (source, edition, clause) per task is what makes 2 x effective the ceiling a task can hold.
the_rule.override: A floor the derivation cannot produce, lowered by the director with the reason recorded. Named in every report that uses it, so a lowered floor can never pass as a met one.
the_rule.effective_on_this_tier: RULED PROMPT-126 s1. An effective primary is one a KEY MAY ACTUALLY ANCHOR ON, and on the Internal Auditor tier that is: a 27001 `shall` passage, or an ISO 19011 passage on an audit-practice task. ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27000 are support only here and count toward nothing. lib/tier-anchoring.mjs is the one definition, read by the gate, the writer prompt and this floor.
the_rule.temporary: `temporary: true` means the task goes live BELOW its floor because the reason it is short is a defect being fixed, not a thin map. verify-cert reports it as a WARN and names it: never a pass, never a fail. It must carry a reason as well as a ruling.

per_task_overrides._what: Each entry is a director ruling with its reason. Empty at creation: PROMPT-126 s3 ruled that any task still thin after the s1 re-count comes back BY NAME next round rather than being given a floor now.

4.7.reason: map of three short passages; three rounds at 0 of 4 across both writers; the distractor note worked and the remaining failures are a clause-number collision with ISO 19011 4.1. Floor set to the held count (2). NOT temporary: the derivation would give 6, and the director ruled the task closed at what it holds rather than keeping a shortfall open against a map this thin.

3.5.reason: floor = 2 x effective. With the PROMPT-126 s1 rule ISO 19011 A.17 (Conducting interviews) is a valid key anchor, so the task re-counts from 0 keyable primaries to 2 -- but 2 is still under MIN_EFFECTIVE, so it stays labelled too_thin and takes the ruled floor the derivation produces. Its other primary, 19011 3.10, is a DEFINITION: keyable under the tier rule, weak as a key, and worth knowing when the round is read.

map_changes_ruled_here.why: The amended sentence -- `The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.` -- IS the task's subject, and its edition was not in the map at all. `shall`, 21 words, held.
It is a NOTE, modality `can`. Left out by the ruling, and the tier rule would refuse a key on it in any case.
Management review general and results, plus internal audit general -- all `shall`, all held. Takes the task from 2 effective to 5.
